name: Drenka Cloudberry-Passionfruit Fizz
description: A Nordic-corridor brand that crossed over into Meridian 88 through distribution deals, Drenka combines synth-cloudberry with passionfruit concentrate for a dual-tart profile. Known for its distinctive frosted white can with orange marbling.
flavor_profile: Tart cloudberry sharpness hits first — almost astringent — followed by passionfruit's sweeter, more tropical tartness; the two sour notes create a layered effect; moderate sweetness balances but doesn't fully resolve the tartness
cultural_context: Drenka entered M88 through a Nordvik distribution deal five years ago and has slowly built a following in Tier 2-3; its 'imported' status gives it a minor prestige bump in neighborhoods where it's sold — though it's manufactured in the Lakeward industrial zone, not imported at all.
story_hooks: Nordvik's 'imported from Scandinavia' marketing is a complete fabrication — the drinks are locally produced under license, and an investigative mesh journalist is about to break the story.

Drenka's distinctive frosted cans are being counterfeited and used to smuggle small quantities of a neural disruptor paste across checkpoint zones — the cans are indistinguishable without a spectrometer.
A Tier 2 teenager disappeared after last being seen buying a Drenka from a specific vending stack in the Midden — the stack's transaction logs have been wiped.
